en.t: I came to Tokyo and entered high school.

units.source_text: 那时候的高中生比现在要蛮横、粗野得多。

en.t: High school students in those days were far more rough and unruly than they are now.

units.source_text: 我的一个朋友，一天晚上和工匠打架，竟用木屐打破了人家的脑袋。

en.t: One evening, a friend of mine got into a fight with a workman and even split the man's head open with a wooden clog.

units.source_text: 因为喝醉了酒，在胡乱打斗时，他的学生帽被对方抢去了，

en.t: Because he was drunk, and while they were wildly fighting, his student cap was snatched away by the other man,

units.source_text: 帽衬里的菱形白布片上清清楚楚地写着他本人的名字。

en.t: and his own name was written plainly on a diamond-shaped piece of white cloth inside the cap.

units.source_text: 这回可麻烦了，他险些被警方告到学校。

en.t: That made things troublesome, and he came very close to being reported to the school by the police.

units.source_text: 幸而有朋友们多方周旋，事情总算未闹大。

en.t: Fortunately, his friends worked hard in various ways, and in the end the matter did not become public.

units.source_text: 这么粗野、荒唐的事，你们这些成长在当今这样文明的社会风气中的年轻人听来，一定会觉得愚蠢之极吧。

en.t: To young people like you, raised in today's civilized social atmosphere, such rough and absurd behavior must sound utterly foolish.

units.source_text: 其实，我也觉得很愚蠢，然而，他们身上却有着如今的学生所没有的质朴。

en.t: In truth, I also think it was very foolish, but they had a simplicity that students today no longer possess.

units.source_text: 那时候，叔叔每月给我的钱，要比现在你父亲寄给你的学费少多了

en.t: At that time, the money my uncle gave me each month was far less than the school expenses your father sends you now

units.source_text: （当然物价跟那时候也不一样）。

en.t: of course, prices were different then as well.

units.source_text: 尽管很少，我也没有觉得不够用，而且在众多同学之中，

en.t: Even though it was little, I never felt it was insufficient, and among my many classmates,

units.source_text: 我绝不至可怜到在经济上羡慕别人的地步。

en.t: I was certainly not so badly off that I envied others financially.

units.source_text: 现在想来，也许自己倒是被别人羡慕的吧，

en.t: Looking back now, perhaps I was actually the one others envied,

units.source_text: 因为，我除了每月固定的汇款外，

en.t: because, in addition to the fixed remittance I received each month,

units.source_text: 还常常向叔叔要买书的钱（我从那时起就喜欢买书）和一些临时费用，

en.t: I often asked my uncle for money to buy books, since I already liked buying books then, and for other occasional expenses,
so I was able to spend as freely as I wished.
